note: L8-6 own wallet fixed vectors. Expected values come from sources independent of the code under test (see sources). Read by backend jest, web vitest, desktop cargo and the contract tests.

sources.ownWalletStatus: Python transcription of design 2.0 (boolean rules 1-5, legacyCustodyStoppedV1)
sources.ownAccountSwitched: Python transcription of design 7.1 R-a' item 2
sources.execMode: hand-written from design W2.5 (d); selectors from pure-python keccak
sources.paymasterRules: hand-written from design 7.3 and decisions A14 (mainnet rule only, nothing configured)
sources.guardians: hand-written from design R3-M2 (ascending, distinct, non-zero, at most 16)
sources.salt: pure-python keccak over abi.encodePacked(prefix, uint32 saltIndex), design W1.1 / W1.3
sources.kernelAddress: eth_call KernelFactory.getAddress(initData, salt) on 97 and 84532 public RPC (S2, read-only)
sources.userOpHash: eth_call EntryPoint v0.7 getUserOpHash on 97 and on 84532 public RPC (S2, read-only)
sources.webauthnSignature: soft P-256 key (vector only) signed with node crypto; expected = eth_call WebAuthnValidator.validateSignatureWithData on 97 (S2, read-only)

cases.name: none: no rows, legacy custody present
owner_mismatch: a row owned by someone else
owner_mismatch: a lost row on another chain owned by someone else
lost: only a lost row on the configured chain
lost: only a row on another chain
pending: deployed, legacy, not confirmed, never activated
active: deployed, legacy, activated before (legacy written later)
pending: lost row activated before, new row not deployed (legacy stays stopped)
pending: N not deployed although act is true
active: N deployed, legacy, not confirmed, act true
lost: lost row with only own_wallet_activated_at stays stopped
lost: lost row with cutover confirmed stays stopped
active: re-enabled main switch, same rows

ownAccountSwitched.name: pending with a legacy address, never activated: false
activated before, new row not deployed: true
pending without a legacy address: true
pending without a legacy address, mpc_wallet_id written later (own_account_switched_at set): still true

execMode.name: too short for selector + mode + offset

paymasterRules.name: mainnet rule: empty refused when a pin exists
mainnet rule: shorter than an address refused

kernelAddress.name: agent, key A, index 0, initConfig not empty (must give another address)

webauthnSignature.name: s in the high half (N - s), usePrecompile=True
s in the high half (N - s), usePrecompile=False
